about.label: About
about.heading: I build the logic behind things.
about.bio1: Hi! I'm Lucio, a Full Stack Developer grounded in the MERN/PERN stack. I build dynamic interfaces with React and design efficient backend services with Node.js, Express, and Java/Spring Boot, always thinking about how systems work as a whole.
about.bio2: I write clean, scalable code, aiming to optimize both user experience and server performance. I bring AI tools like Claude Code into my workflow to speed up development, and I'm here to help with your next project.
